scope: Intermediate spring section and root transition, centered tool release, shaped hardware bearing and measured water-regulator shoulder. Physical force, retention, fatigue and pump vibration await this trial.

centered_pry_entry.position: Centered along each hook. The flat 2.6 mm overlap continues on either side; the spring wall remains continuous.
centered_pry_entry.blade: Flathead blade no wider than 5 mm and no thicker than 1 mm.

pisco.neck_scope: Exposed outlet neck before the release collet.
pisco.body_stock: Broad central bearing between independent spring leaves.
pisco.neck_lip: Raised central lip around the short exposed neck.

physical_diagnosis.finding: The tested bridge was below the complete admitted neck circle, so its nominal neck lip did not exist.

meter.lead_route: Retain the accepted receiver and westward lead room above the lower leaf.

physical_diagnosis.finding: The broad stepped receiver envelope extends past the true body shoulder and the low cap bridge misses the hardware. The scan scale is retained; the cavity uses the measured linear profile in its actual installed frame.

pump.hardware_cavity: Retain the accepted box half-pipe and continuous fixed rail seats.
pump.base_fracture_observation: Recorded only; no geometry change is based on the fracture photo.

asse.hardware_cavity: Retain the accepted threaded hardware fit.

print_orientation: All five caps stand on an axial end; wing bending lies in the layer plane. Receivers retain parent production orientation.
post_processing: Retain accessible automatic cavity supports. Remove them with a tiny flathead screwdriver that fits inside the cavity; preserve the hook bearings.
